ui_bugs.issue: All 5 non-'All' sub-tabs (adhesive/grout/sealant/cleaning/primer) show count=0 even though 138 products exist in 'All'. The tab testids resolve correctly, but the prop-level match function `(p) => (p.sub_categories || []).some(s => /adhesive/i.test(...))` matches no products. Root cause is product data: the 138 materials products lack `sub_categories` entries containing the keyword patterns (they're classified via product_group='materials' or main_category='Materials'). Not a shell/merge bug — a data-classification / keyword-mismatch issue. Previous iteration 206 showed non-zero counts (Grouts=3, Cleaning=2, Primers=3) with the old DB-driven tabs+keywords, so the DB keywords array previously provided the discriminator that the prop's regex now doesn't cover for the current dataset.

tiles-tab-feature and tiles-tab-mosaic show count=0. tiles-tab-border is MISSING (not in DB config nor prop). Floor=1062 and Wall=54 work fine — so classification for those subgroups works, but Feature/Mosaic keyword regex on sub_categories misses the actual data.
React 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' console warning — pre-existing, unrelated to this migration.

critical_code_review_comments: mergeConfig() in ManagerPageShell.jsx (lines 130-158) is a clean, well-commented fix — prop schema wins for type/options while DB order/additions are preserved. Nicely resolves the silent-upgrade blocker from iteration 206.

Sub-tab .match functions in MaterialsManager/TilesManager only look at sub_categories. Since the isMatch predicate for the whole Manager ALSO accepts products by product_group or main_category, many products pass isMatch but fail every sub-tab match — hence 0 counts. Sub-tab matchers should mirror the same breadth (name + sub_categories + main_category) or fall back to 'name contains keyword'.
ManagerPageShell.jsx is now 699 lines — right at the 700-line ceiling. Extract the Edit dialog into a subcomponent next pass.
